prompt: Create an original 90 second fingerstyle acoustic folk instrumental composition for science explainer, tutorial and educational narration. Mood: curious, clear, thoughtful. Instruments: steel-string guitar, mandolin, light hand percussion. Style: alternating bass picking and a clear acoustic melody. Tempo approximately 92 BPM; G major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Keep the lead sparse and the midrange uncluttered for spoken narration. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A gentle and relaxing instrumental piece featuring fingerpicked acoustic guitar, light bass, and soft drums, creating a calm and mellow atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首轻柔放松的器乐曲，以指弹原声吉他为主，配以轻柔的贝斯和鼓点，营造出平静而悠扬的氛围。
